question: Add a context parameter to the Filter interface in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml. The Filter interface (with its single method Filter(object *RNode) (*RNode, error)) is the core abstraction for all YAML transformations in kustomize's kyaml library. Changing it to Filter(ctx context.Context, object *RNode) (*RNode, error) breaks all existing Filter implementations including SetAnnotation, ClearAnnotation, and any custom filters. Downstream consumers like Helm that pass Filter values to RNode.PipeE() would also be affected.
